scope: Read every nonretail paragraph and its own-date cited headline metadata; manually checked facts, companies, preview versus outcome, release timing, numerical direction and timeframe; checked all quoted market figures against own card and ran verifier. Retail keys excluded.

findings.finding: Currency symbols and several index levels needed explicit units; clarified without changing values.

China local-debt package and CPI outcomes are dated before the cutoff; no future US policy or direct-stimulus outcome is asserted. Crypto uses the November 10 UTC daily close; listed assets and Treasury use the November 8 completed close. Polish Independence Day creates no invented local November 11 session.

actions.action: Made currency or index-point units explicit; market values and claims unchanged.
